limitations: One prospective diagnostic after two disclosed negative network fits; no preceding arm is rerun.
Two independent dense fields, exactly zero initialized without randomness;1024float32 parameters specific to the two synthetic scenes. No learned network or common function across observations.

The same original scenes, forward splatting with normalized collisions, and equal image L1 weights at widths1/3/7 are retained. Only future RGB images supervise; no true displacement, mask or identity labels.
256Adam updates, batch2, lr0.05 in pixel-coordinate units, beta0.9/0.999, epsilon1e-8, no weight decay, max gradient norm1; no sweep, new initialization or extension.

Final native RGB L1 must remain strictly below0.01171875. Filtered objectives and reconstruction separation are separately reported. Final fields, coverages and RGB arrays are diagnostic evidence only.

A positive fit shows feasibility only under the declared free-field parameterization and optimizer; it cannot uniquely identify why the network fit failed. A negative fit is not an impossibility proof.
Fitting and measurement use the same two scenes. No generalization, Atari competence, perception, transfer or accelerated learning is established by either outcome.
CPU only with one numerical thread, no emulator, real archive or GPU.300second cooperative work bound excluding proof hashing. No reusable agent checkpoint.
One attempt, no retry. An optimizer exception may follow a partial update; retain the in-progress marker. Finally persists it, while a hard kill leaves a started marker uncertain, never restartable.
Original results and independent reviews, exact source closure, committed protocol and independent preflight must precede the first real field update.
